title: Air Stunts and Trick Detection Engine
description: Implement backflip, frontflip, 360-spin aerial stunts with combo multipliers and animated score callouts.

title: Tire Skid Marks and Drift Dust Particles
description: Create dynamic particle dust when braking or turning hard, plus skid mark meshes on the asphalt.

title: Time Trial Checkpoint Racing Circuit
description: Add neon checkpoint gates along the road circuit, active timer, split times, and best lap record saved to localStorage.

title: Turbo Boost Pads and Nitro Effect
description: Place glowing boost pads on roads that give speed bursts (+50% speed for 2.5s) and camera FOV zoom effect.

title: Village and Environment Expansion
description: Add low-poly cottages, wooden fences, street benches, and a tunnel through the northern hill.

title: Bike Customization and Paint Shop
description: Interactive garage UI to customize bicycle frame colors (Neon Cyan, Lava Red, Acid Green, Cyber Gold) and cyclist helmet styles.

title: Dynamic Weather and Rain FX
description: Add rain particles, darkening storm clouds, wet asphalt shimmer, and thunder audio synthesis.

title: Wheel World Frankenstein Modular Bike System & 3D Model Overhaul
description: Overhaul procedural 3D bicycle with realistic stylized hydroformed frame, front suspension fork, disc brake rotors, knobby/aero wheels, 1x drivetrain/cassette, riser/drop bars, articulated cyclist with IK pedaling legs, and 6-slot modular parts builder (Frame, Fork, Wheels, Bars, Drivetrain, Saddle) affecting Power, Aero, Handling, and Grip.

title: Wheel World Arcade UI & Co-Op Workshop HUD
description: Redesign HUD with bold retro-modern sports typography (Chakra Petch & Teko), angled badges, arcade speedometer, dynamic turbo speed streaks, and 360 rotating garage showcase view.

title: Dynamic Physics Obstacles & Traffic Cones
description: Add knockable traffic cones, roadblock hurdles, and bowling pins that react dynamically to bicycle impacts with bounce, tumble physics, and smash audio.

title: Procedural Synthwave Chiptune BGM Synthesizer
description: Add a procedural Web Audio API synthwave/chiptune music player with bassline, arpeggios, and drums.

title: Ghost Bike Record Lap Racing
description: Record player's best lap replay path and spawn a transparent glowing neon ghost cyclist to race against.
